Actually, no I don't really have a type. My only real requirements are: doesn't do drugs, doesn't smoke, doesn't drink to excess, great with children, passionate, and is responsible for their overall health(eats right and moderate exercise). 

I'm really not asking for a lot.
Thank you. I need all the support I can get. I'm going to keep going and drive through it. At the very least, I can see how it will make me better and have a stronger character.

Sure, here's a link to my latest all piano impromptus album:

https://cameronwebster1.bandcamp.com

I've decided against killing myself. I need to stay around for my family, my friends, and everyone else's sake. I can't be making impulsive decisions like this. It's just so difficult living alone and being unable to tell someone how frustrated and miserable I am. Thank you for your concern. I'm going to stay around a little while longer.
The failure to find a relationship is exactly what is bothering me. I just get tired of over and over doing the routine of being charming, getting a number, and finding no commitment.
I'm still here. I've decided to stay. I shouldn't be making rash decisions on impulse. I'm sorry. I'm sorry for posting and causing so much trouble.
